mapper.insert: INSERT INTO suspension (doctor_id, schedule_id, suspend_date, period, reason, action_taken, target_doctor_id) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{scheduleId}, #{suspendDate}, #{period}, #{reason}, #{actionTaken}, #{targetDoctorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE suspension SET doctor_id = #{doctorId}, schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, suspend_date = #{suspendDate}, period = #{period}, reason = #{reason}, action_taken = #{actionTaken}, target_doctor_id = #{targetDoctorId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_id, suspend_date, period, reason, action_taken, target_doctor_id, created_at, updated_at FROM suspension WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_id, suspend_date, period, reason, action_taken, target_doctor_id, created_at, updated_at FROM suspension WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND suspend_date = #{suspendDate}
